posts.raw_content:
---
### YOU LET THE SNAKE IN, FOOLISH WOMAN!

According to an AI conversation with Gemini, the argument by courts is that CNN has some kind of 1st amendment related 5th amendment due process infringement because the press pass was GIVEN to them by the WH and then revoked.

Because it was given and then revoked, somehow that creates a first amendment related 5th amendment problem.  Specifically, that they had an interest with the press pass that was removed without notice

---
> *The ruling is not grounded in a "property interest" in the traditional sense.  The actual legal theory is more specific and comes from Sherrill v. Knight (1977, D.C. Circuit):*

> *A White House press credential implicates a First Amendment liberty interest — specifically, the interest in performing the function of the press.*

> *That First Amendment liberty interest is what triggers Fifth Amendment procedural due process protections when the government moves to revoke an existing credential.  The government must provide: (1) notice of the factual bases for revocation, (2) an opportunity to respond, and (3) a written statement of reasons — before taking the pass.*

> ***The due process protection kicks in when the government takes away an existing benefit.  These reporters held hard passes that had been issued through the White House's own credentialing system. The government created the system, issued the passes, and then revoked them without the required procedural steps***. *You, as someone who never held a credential, wouldn't have the same claim because the government is making a discretionary initial grant, not a revocation.*

---
If the requirement for having been issued the credentials were not there, then 500M Americans, and countless small news outlets could do the same thing as CNN, because everyone has a 1st amendment right, and there is nothing legally in law or in the constitution that DEMANDS ACCESS to the WH press room.

Also, and more relevantly, INFOWARS and the Gateway Pundit could sue the WH for NOT giving them press pass and denying THEM access to the press room.

It might've been able to sue CNN and other Media Outlets for blocking their access to the WH Press room, were it the case they could do this legal bullshit without the "interest" of the golden ticket of white house access privilege.

YOU LET THE G D SNAKE IN, STUPID WOMAN!

This maneuvering is all legal, but highly manueveringinconsistent and illogical gobbledygook to me, and to rational thinking people.

But CNN lawyers found a way to make an argument that injuncts the WH.

I think its stupid.

So does everyone I talk to.

"They can't do that!"

Well they did.

---
## ***HOW TO FIX IT***

According to this same AI, there is no legal reason why the White House cannot simply close down the White House Press room and say to the public "We're not doing this any more.  They can report their own news. They can read about the white house through our websites' press releases"

And that would be that

THEN the White House can revoke ALL the white house press passes, and consider them NULL AND VOID since there is no more white house press room

THEN the White House can develop a DUE PROCESS for giving access to a new press room, or just say they are going to choose which outlets get to be there, each and every week.  NO MORE PRESS CREDENTIALS

This would allow INFOWARS, Gateway Pundit, or NAME YOUR FAV OUTLET to actually go there for once

Instead of these entrenched, deepstate institution fake news outlets which are the enemy of the people.
